Hi Jenna — thanks for sending this. I pulled the export and see the same credit entries on our AR ledger.

Quick answers up front:
- We can either apply the credits to open invoices (net-zero your outstanding balance) or move them to a suspense clearing account pending revenue mapping if you need an audit trail tied to revenue recognition.
- Typical turnaround for straightforward application is 3 business days once we have the confirmation of which invoices you want covered. If you want us to hold as a reserve for rev-rec mapping, that can take up to two weeks while Revenue validates impact.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Marcus (cc) will propose a suggested allocation for your review based on our invoice apply rules.
- Please confirm whether EverBuild prefers immediate application to open invoices or to hold for revenue mapping.

I've attached the export you sent for reference and flagged the three highest-value credits.

Best,

Team —

I reviewed the notes on C-7621. That credit was originally issued as a pilot rebate tied to usage-based revenue that we recognized across Q3–Q4 of 2024. Because the underlying revenue has already been recognized, we should not apply C-7621 to open invoices (that would create a revenue reversal). Instead recommended treatment is:

1) Move C-7621 ($7,100) to a suspense account temporarily (RBW-999-SUSP) and create a contra-revenue journal reversing the original revenue recognition entry that corresponds to the pilot period.
2) Post a correcting journal to clear the suspense account once the reversals complete. 

If we proceed with Marcus's suggested immediate application for the other two credits, I'll prepare the rev-rec reversal package and proposed journal details (GL journal id RBW-JNL-2026-11-03-REV) to attach to the ticket for audit. That will require one-week lead time for review by Revenue Ops and 72 hours for the actual posting.

If EverBuild prefers a single-step close (apply all credits now), we need to warn them about the potential revenue restatement exposure for C-7621.

—Naomi
Manager, Revenue Operations
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
